short_bio: Senegalese-Italian TikTok creator known for wordless reaction videos.
biography:
Khaby Lame was born in Dakar, Senegal, and moved with his family to Chivasso, near Turin, as a child. He worked in a factory operating machine tools and lost the job at the start of 2020.

He began posting on TikTok that year. His videos are wordless: he watches an overcomplicated “life hack” and dismisses it with a shrug and an open-handed gesture at the obvious simple solution.

In June 2022 he passed Charli D’Amelio to become the most-followed person on TikTok, and he was granted Italian citizenship the same year.

timeline.title: Becomes the most-followed account on TikTok and receives Italian citizenship
